title: The Power of Dreams! Proof of Strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I purposely get up early and
head to the grounds. I've
got a plan.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Much as I'd rather not, maybe I
should skip the turf today. But
then again,
I wouldn't want to cut my practice session
this short...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're that trainer! What are you
doing here? Did you wake up
early again?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Really?! I-I mean, you would do that? We
just met the other day!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Me, compete on turf... Do you think I'll
really be able to go
toe-to-toe with
Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look her straight in the eyes, then nod.
I'll handle all the checks and
maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Then I'll work as hard as I possibly can! Assuming that's all right with you, of course!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to start practicing with you!
And I swear—I'll bring you
victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, after her classes, Bamboo Memory
and I meet up to discuss our
plans.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So basically, I can train, but foot care
comes first! ...Or something like
that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a good reason she's been
practicing on dirt. It's more difficult
to gain
speed on dirt, so it puts less strain on her
feet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, it is easier to run faster
on turf, but the tradeoff is
that it puts
more strain on the feet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With how brittle her nails are, I can't
switch Bamboo entirely to turf
yet. We're
going to take the transition gradually and
focus on
strengthening her nails first.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! I mean, you know I'd love to get
out there and run this
instant, but still!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Learning to take care of my nails is still
learning! I promise, I'll follow
all your
instructions to a tee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a new day, and...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer! What's with the cutesy
little bottles?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Cuticle? Oh, is that the stuff for nails?
Those'll make them stronger,
right? Are
you gonna teach me how they work?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Racers need to be in tip-top condition. I'm
going to show her how to
moisturize and
shield her nails so she can keep them in
good shape.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, sounds good! But just so you
know, I've never done
pedicures or even
painted my nails before.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So please, explain it all in extra detail! I
wanna make sure I can do it
myself too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And on yet another day...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We're turning up the heat with this one!
Red-hot routine—step
twenty! Lightspeed
Launches and Falcon Swoop Sweeerves!
...And
done!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! The new-and-improved
red-hot routine you made is
working great!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can tell—the steps are new, but it's
still got Dad's style! It
really gets you
pumped to work out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The only critique I've got is that I kiiinda
wish there were more laps
on the track.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: True! Heheh, Dad says that a lot too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "You've gotta take red-hot breaks to stay in red-hot shape!" ...So I'm gonna rest harder than ANYONE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Days later, I catch Bamboo Memory gazing
wistfully at the
Umamusume training on
the track.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Deep down, I'm feeling pretty
restless!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But you gave me your word. You promised
that you'd get me ready
for turf, and I
know you meant it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So I'll trust your judgment. 'Cause a good
athlete never loses faith in
those they
trust! Dad taught me better than to give
up hope now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wait, why're you thanking me?! I'm the one who should be grateful for all you do!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, speaking of which! Remember the
cuticle oil you got me? I'm
almost out, so
could you tell me where you got it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at a bit of a loss for words. It's
surprisingly hard to get students to

maintain routines outside lessons. Most
would've forgotten the
tedious
maintenance stuff by now...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The drugstore? Gotcha! I'll zip over and
restock, so leave the nail
care stuff to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't even been that long since we met,
but Bamboo's so
dedicated to everything I
teach her... It just goes to show what a
hard
worker she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And most of all, it drives home just how
determined she is to make
her dreams
come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We keep up our training, and several days
later, around the time
Bamboo opens her
second bottle of cuticle oil...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her steps are light and smooth, and I'm
pleased to see that she's cut
down her
time drastically from her early turf runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've still gotta stay vigilant and make
sure we're not putting too
much strain on
Bamboo's feet, but for now...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (All right, I've got this. And now...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll have a shot against Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the effort she's been pouring into
training and maintenance is
paying off
two-fold! If we keep this up, she's going to
accomplish big
things!
